a1-11.title: The big match
a1-11.story: Anna and Max are at the sports [[club]]. Taras has a football [[match]] today. Anna is a big [[fan]] of his team. At the [[start]], Taras is very nervous. Then he kicks the ball and scores a [[goal]]! After the game, the kids play [[volleyball]] together. At home, Dad is watching a boxing [[fight]]. But Taras is sleeping on the sofa.

a2-01.title: Breakfast at the café
a2-01.story: On Sunday morning, Anna and Max went to a small café. The waiter gave them the [[menu]]. Anna ordered [[toast]] with strawberry [[jam]]. Max wanted a big cheese [[omelet]] and a [[cola]]. It came with tomato [[sauce]] on the side. Then Max saw the cakes and ordered a [[dessert]] too. Anna put a small cookie in her bag as a [[snack]]. At noon, Max was hungry again, so Anna gave him the cookie.

a2-02.title: What's for dinner?
a2-02.story: On Friday, the family talked about dinner. Taras wanted [[spaghetti]] with meatballs. Mama wanted chicken [[curry]], and Dad wanted a [[steak]]. Grandma said, "I can make [[pasta]] for everyone." But Grandpa had a better idea: a [[barbecue]] in the backyard! Mama put a red [[chili]] in the sauce. Taras tried it and drank three glasses of water. Later he said, "Next time, let's just get [[fast food]]!"

a2-03.title: A new sweater
a2-03.story: It was cold, so Anna and Lisa went shopping for a [[sweater]]. One shop had a big [[sale]] that week. Anna liked one [[model]], but she wanted it in blue. The [[material]] was soft, and the price was good. Lisa said, "This [[brand]] is great. My jacket is from them." The seller also showed them a new [[product]], a soft winter hat. At the checkout, Anna paid in [[cash]]. But she needed fifty more [[cents|cent]]! Lisa smiled and gave her the coins.

a2-04.title: At the barber's
a2-04.story: Like every [[teenager]], Max wanted a new look. On Saturday, he went to the [[barber]] near his house. "I want [[blonde]] hair," he said. The barber laughed, "That's a [[crazy]] idea, but okay!" He also gave Max a new [[style]] with short sides. After an hour, he put some [[cream]] on Max's hair. Max looked in the mirror and loved it. At home, Sofia asked, "What happened to your hair?" "It's a [[secret]]," Max said with a smile.

a2-05.title: A busy Saturday
a2-05.story: On Saturday, the family got ready for Taras's birthday party. Mama hired a [[cleaner]] to help with the house. Grandma put cookies in a big plastic [[container]]. Dad used a [[drill]] to hang a [[dinosaur]] poster. But he hit a [[metal]] pipe, and water came out! Now the family was in big [[trouble]]. Luckily, Mama's helper knew how to fix pipes. In the afternoon, a funny [[clown]] came to the party. Taras said, "I will remember this day [[forever]]!"

a2-06.title: At the airport
a2-06.story: Anna and her dad were at the airport early. Max texted her, "Have a good trip, and stay in [[contact]]!" First, Anna filled in a form with her name, age, and [[gender]]. At passport [[control]], a woman checked her [[ID]]. Then an [[alarm]] rang loudly when Dad walked through. A [[policeman]] checked his bag and found only keys. On the plane, a friendly [[pilot]] said hello to Anna. He told her many interesting [[details|detail]] about flying. Now Anna wants to fly planes one day!

a2-07.title: A city tour
a2-07.story: Ira's uncle from Canada came to Kyiv as a [[visitor]]. Anna and Ira took him on a walking [[tour]]. The city [[center]] was full of happy [[tourists|tourist]]. There was a bus [[strike]], so they took the metro. The metro [[escalator]] was very long and deep. Near a church, they saw a beautiful stone [[angel]]. Ira took a [[portrait]] of her uncle next to it. The photo had strong [[contrast]] between the white stone and blue sky. Her uncle said, "This is my favorite photo of the trip!"
